title: DeletionRequestAccepted
description: Acknowledgment returned when a deletion request is accepted for processing.

job_id.description: Identifier of the created deletion job. Use it to poll job status.

submitted_count.description: Number of identifiers received in the request.

created_at.description: Time the job was created, in ISO 8601 format.

DeletionJobStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a deletion job. `queued` and `in_progress` are non-terminal; `completed`, `partial`, and `failed` are terminal.
DeletionJobStatus.title: DeletionJobStatus
